title: BrainQuake example SEEG data: ictal and interictal stereo-EEG from 8 epilepsy patients (Tsinghua Yuquan Hospital)
description: Stereo-EEG (SEEG) recordings from eight patients with drug-resistant epilepsy, recorded at the Epilepsy Center of Tsinghua Yuquan Hospital during pre-surgical monitoring. The dataset provides the example data for the BrainQuake toolbox: a 71-second ictal clip per patient for epileptogenicity index analysis, and interictal segments of up to about 2 hours for high-frequency event detection. The data were sampled at 2000 Hz and organized in iEEG-BIDS without signal processing. Imaging volumes are not redistributed.
methods_description: SEEG depth electrode recordings were acquired at 2000 Hz during about two weeks of pre-surgical monitoring. MRI was acquired before implantation and CT after implantation. Ictal clips and interictal segments were exported as EDF/EDF+D files. EDF+ clinical annotations are listed in the events files.

funding_references.funder_name: National Key R&D Program of China
